prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Grid Redesign: Redesign the companion selection step into a compact grid layout to reduce scrolling and friction during pet adoption.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Choose Your Companion"}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Accessories Sub-Flow: Add a pet accessory selection step right after picking a pet to increase emotional attachment before final adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_accessories", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_accessories": {"headline": "Style Your Companion", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Starter Accessory", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Split Screen Layout: Redesign the sign-in screen to a split layout showcasing animated pet companions alongside authentication options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Save Your Companion Progress"}}
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Personality Quiz Screen: Insert a personality quiz screen prior to choose_path to help guide users to their preferred companion type.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_personality_quiz", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_personality_quiz": {"headline": "Find Your Ideal Companion", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Playful or Calm?", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Card Carousel Redesign: Redesign the initial story intro screen into an interactive card carousel showcasing desktop pet features.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion"}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Quick Passwordless Hint: Add a clear hint highlighting fast passwordless magic link sign-in directly on the sign-in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your email for instant magic link login. No password required."}}
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Full Bleed Layout: Change the final home intro layout to a full bleed presentation showcasing the desktop pet arrival.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready"}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward: Add a prominent companion owner milestone badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Companion Guardian", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desk Docking Visual: Add an animation component to the waiting screen illustrating how the pet docks on the user's desktop screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "label": "Desktop Docking Preview", "asset": "asset:desk_dock_preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint: Add a explicit hint on the final home intro screen explaining system tray controls for managing the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Click the system tray icon anytime to minimize, customize, or chat with your pet."}}
